parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, border targeting, detention practice, or enforced facility ban is documented, and social acceptance is evidenced by large Pride/trans marches and a progressive reputation. The main visitor-facing friction is restroom/changing-room discrimination and very poor all-gender toilet signage/standards, with rising anti-gender rhetoric as a climate risk. Resident surgical ID rules do not govern a visitor's home passport and are not documented to affect foreign documents. Protections exist but are largely resident-facing climate signals.

entry_documents.exposure: Not documented. No entry, exit, visa or border-screening rule for trans visitors, and no documented rejection of foreign passports or X markers.
entry_documents.protection: Visitor uses home passport; no documented traveler-facing document mismatch regime. Resident surgical ID requirement is not documented to apply to visitors.
entry_documents.interaction: Resident ID mismatch cannot be extrapolated to foreign documents without documented border practice.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Not documented. No arrests, detention, custody placement or forced examinations of trans visitors documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No traveler-specific detention protocol documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Documented friction: 17% of discrimination reports by trans/gender-neutral respondents occurred in restrooms/changing rooms; only 5 of 149 listed all-gender toilets met standards in Nov 2025.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Government investing NT$280m to double gender-neutral bathrooms 623 to 1,246 by 2029. No legal bathroom ban documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Poor signage/standards increase outing friction in public facilities despite no documented criminal penalty.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. Resident care/assisted-reproduction restrictions do not document visitor denial. Court denied resident marker change without surgery in Aug 2024, appeal unresolved.
care_services.protection: Health ministry recognised self-determination as human right since 2013; Long-Term Care Act covers gender identity. These are climate signals, not documented visitor care guarantees.
care_services.interaction: Resident ID requirement could affect resident clinic interactions; no documented visitor medication, HRT import or emergency-care denial.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Rising anti-gender activity, external anti-trans agendas supported, party calling for 'two genders' position; pending conscription changes described as potential harm but unspecified.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex activity legal; education and employment anti-discrimination laws with fines; 2017 constitutional interpretation EJ protected. No trans-expression crime documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Anti-gender rhetoric raises social friction but no documented state enforcement against visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented for visiting minors/guardians. Resident referendum banned LGBT-inclusive school sex education; pending conscription changes unresolved and resident-specific.
minors_guardians.protection: Conversion therapy effectively banned 2018; adoption by same-sex/single LGBT people since 2023 are resident climate signals, not visitor protections.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented visitor minor entry, schooling, care or custody rule.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented. No trans-specific homicide/violence rate, police targeting, extortion or attacks on visitors documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Not documented as traveler-facing. Large Pride marches (170,000 in 2019) and 3,000-person trans march in 2025 suggest open public expression.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence of violence evidence is not safety; no magnitude can be stated.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Unknowns: border practice, violence rate, appeal outcome on ID marker, conscription proposal status, and methodology for 90% blocked figure are unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Education/employment fines and constitutional equality interpretation are documented resident remedies; no documented visitor complaint outcome.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved questions are lighter than documented exposures and do not outweigh documented acceptance and absence of criminalisation.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in having protections with delays/friction, but this case lacks documented visitor detention or care denial and has stronger documented public acceptance, so somewhat safer than 0.75.

Similar progressive climate and no criminalisation, but lower because facilities discrimination and poor all-gender toilet standards are documented, anti-gender activity is rising, and traveler-facing remedies/violence data are not documented.
Safer than 0.65: no documented document-mismatch detention, intrusive questioning or custody threat; remedies are weaker on paper for visitors but no comparable initial state friction is documented.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national law criminalises nothing trans-specific and society shows high visibility/acceptance, while the operative visitor risk is everyday facilities friction and rising anti-gender climate, not state detention or exclusion. Resident surgical ID and conscription issues do not document visitor exposure. Interaction is therefore low-severity friction with uncertain border/violence unknowns, placing the case in Reduced Risk, above 0.75 anchors with documented detention/care friction and below 0.85 anchors with documented working visitor protections.
